name: 2C-Bu
summary: 2C-Bu, also known as 4-butyl-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine and 2C families. It is the 2C analogue of the DOx derivative DOBU.

pharmacology.text: 2C-Bu is a potent and high-efficacy serotonin 5-HT2A receptor partial agonist, with an EC50 of 3.9 to 29 nM and an Emax of 71 to 93%.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: 2C-Bu was not included in Alexander Shulgin's book PiHKAL (Phenethylamines I Have Known and Loved) and its properties and effects in humans are unknown.

summaryZh: 2C-Bu，化學名：2,5-二甲氧基-4-丁基苯乙胺是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C14H23NO2，屬於2,5-二甲氧基苯乙胺衍生物（2C類化合物），結構上相關的化合物還有2C-iBu、2C-tBu和2C-sBu。
